title: Derivation of Final Velocities in 1D Head-on Elastic Collision
governing_principles: Conservation of Linear Momentum: m_1 u_1 + m_2 u_2 = m_1 v_1 + m_2 v_2
Conservation of Kinetic Energy: \frac{1}{2} m_1 u_1^2 + \frac{1}{2} m_2 u_2^2 = \frac{1}{2} m_1 v_1^2 + \frac{1}{2} m_2 v_2^2
assumptions: Perfect elasticity (no energy converted to heat or deformation)

derivation_steps.description: Rearrange the linear momentum conservation equation.
Rearrange the kinetic energy conservation equation.
Divide step 3 by step 1 (assuming v1 != u1), proving that relative speed of approach equals relative speed of separation.
Express v2 in terms of v1.
Substitute v2 back into the momentum conservation equation.

derivation_steps.equation: v_1 = \left(\frac{m_1 - m_2}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_1 + \left(\frac{2 m_2}{m_1 + m_2}\right) u_2
derivation_steps.description: Solve for v1. By symmetry swapping indices 1 and 2, v2 is obtained.

limiting_cases: Equal masses (m1 = m2): v1 = u2 and v2 = u1 (complete velocity exchange).
Heavy stationary target (m2 >> m1, u2 = 0): v1 = -u1 (particle bounces back with original speed).
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 pp. 165-167; HRW Ch 9 pp. 246-247; UP Ch 8 pp. 279-280
